goal_a_reason: Free-text replies can be paraphrased, so semantic similarity scored by an LLM judge is needed instead of a deterministic string match.
goal_b_reason: Structured JSON output with known expected values should be compared with tolerance for key ordering and minor whitespace — json-similarity handles this deterministically without an LLM.
goal_c_reason: A literal substring presence check ('deployment succeeded') is a binary pass/fail that contains handles directly with no LLM required.
